snippet.title: Pixel Sorter Factory - Full Official Trailer | Pixel Art Factory Automation Game
snippet.description:
Hi everyone! We're MaxFab, the team behind Pixel Sorter Factory.
The steam page is out soooo Go Wishlist on Steam !

You break them into physical pixel cubes and sell the first ones by hand… then build conveyors, sorters, ovens, printers and plinko machines until the whole factory runs on its own.
#indiegame #pixelart #factorygame
